notes.title: Speyarranoth Minor Update
notes.notes:
* Added health bar and score. Added game over scene.
 * Lower initial volume from 1 to 0.25.
 * Add options menu for graphics and sound. Options button no longer disabled.
 * Spawn stars closer so they move when you move.
 * Change friction coefficient from 0.999 to 0.995 so spaceship stops moving when you don't press keys.

notes.title: Added Menu and Title Track
notes.notes: I added a menu and a title track that plays while menu is active.
